vo: This is Arc. Circle's new chain. Every day, fresh memecoins launch here, and everyone wants a piece of the Arc economy.
Meet Sam. Sam spots a new coin, up sixty nine percent, and apes in five hundred dollars.
What Sam can't see: three wallets bought in the very first block. All funded by the same address. Together, they hold a third of the supply.
Twelve minutes later, they sell. Five hundred dollars, gone. Sam just got bundled.
This happens every single day. Bundled launches. No community. No trust. New people come to build on Arc, and get drained instead.
So we built Arc Memecoin Intel. One command adds it to Claude Code, Codex, or any agent.

Paste a contract address. It reads the chain and shows you everything before you spend a cent: bundled wallets, shared funders, who holds the supply, whether liquidity can be pulled, and a clear risk score.
This time, Sam scans first. Critical risk. Sam walks away, five hundred dollars still in the wallet.
Arc Memecoin Intel. Know where your money goes, before it goes.
